answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 147923 Country: India Title: Is kangaroo meat halal? Question: Is kangaroo meat halal? Answer ID: 147923 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 355/385/SD=6/1438) No. It is haram to eat kangaroo meat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
